products.name: Classic Chatua
products.shortDesc: Traditional grain blend for everyday nourishment.
products.longDesc: Classic Chatua is made from carefully selected grains and pulses, traditionally roasted and finely ground. A wholesome, natural food from Odisha, suitable for everyday nourishment.

products.name: Multi-Grain Chatua
products.shortDesc: A rich blend of multiple grains for complete nutrition.
products.longDesc: A rich blend of several roasted grains and pulses, ground fine for complete, balanced nutrition. Mix it into water, milk or buttermilk and enjoy.

products.name: Jaggery Chatua
products.shortDesc: Natural sweetness with the goodness of jaggery.
products.longDesc: Classic Chatua blended with natural jaggery for gentle sweetness. Ready to stir into a glass of milk or water, with no refined sugar added.

products.name: Protein Chatua
products.shortDesc: High-protein blend for an active lifestyle.
products.longDesc: A pulse-forward blend with extra protein, made for busy mornings, workouts and anyone who wants a filling, natural drink or snack.

productCommon.howToEnjoy: Mix 2 to 3 tablespoons in a glass of cold water, milk or buttermilk. Stir well and drink fresh. You can also add it to breakfast bowls or make ladoos.
productCommon.storage: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place and use a dry spoon each time.

recipes.title: Chatua Drink
recipes.body: Stir 2 tablespoons of Chatua into a glass of cold water or buttermilk. Add a pinch of salt or a little jaggery and drink fresh.

recipes.title: Chatua Breakfast Bowl
recipes.body: Mix 3 tablespoons of Chatua with warm milk, top with banana slices, nuts and a spoon of honey.

recipes.title: Chatua Ladoo
recipes.body: Combine Chatua with melted ghee and grated jaggery, then roll into small ladoos while the mix is warm.
